annotations.title: Convert a date to the Maya calendars

description:
Converts a Gregorian date to the Maya calendars: Tzolk'in day sign and tone as written (e.g. "6 Oc"), kin 1-260, the sign's meaning, direction and trecena, the Haab date, the Long Count and the Julian Day Number. Use it for a Maya day sign or birth sign, or any event's Maya date.

DELEGATE THIS RATHER THAN DERIVING IT: Julian Day Number minus a correlation constant, then remainders mod 20, 13, 260 and 365, where an off-by-one gives a real day sign that is the wrong one. Which constant is the open argument in Maya calendrics: this uses Goodman-Martinez-Thompson 584283 and returns it. Time of day, place and zone do not enter.

CITATION: required. See server instructions.

date.description: Gregorian date to convert, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, year 1-4000, proleptic before 1582. Example: "2012-12-21".
